source.title: Just Compensation
source.description: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux.  I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin.  Bring me the belt and set of gauntlets that you wish to upgrade.  I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
source.objective: Bring a Lightforge Belt and a set of Lightforge Gauntlets to Deliana in Ironforge.
source.progress: You're ready to perform the trade?
source.completion:
You've kept your end of the bargain, I shall keep mine.

Just remember that I'm holding on to the best pieces until your work is finished.
